status: FROZEN on exactly the 23 pinned snapshots
rule_source: Candidate Rule v2, audited in docs/batch7_section_audit_v2.json, reproduced with zero mismatches on the 18 earlier documents and applied to the 5 substituted documents

rule.statement: Sectionization is a syntactic partitioning operation, not semantic document-structure recognition.
rule.candidate_section: ATX heading AND not numeric-only AND not exactly contents/table of contents AND no copyright or URL marker AND length at most 140 characters
rule.section_level: shallowest heading level with at least 2 surviving candidates
rule.split_points: only surviving candidates at the chosen level; rejected headings are plain text, never split points
rule.classification: NORMAL when at least 2 sections survive, DEGENERATE when fewer than 2 survive
rule.degenerate_handling: document-wide stride, explicitly recorded as DEGENERATE, never silently replaced by another sampling rule

audit_result_on_frozen_corpus.degenerate_document: transport_k1_kytc_acfr; zero surviving candidates, its single heading is itself an artefact

largest_section_ratio_above_0.9.treatment: reported observation, not a quality gate

scope_of_freeze: this rule is frozen for the Batch 7 corpus build only; it makes no claim to recognise genuine scientific sections in general
